title.narrative: Output 1.1. Increased institutional capacity of employer and business membership organizations (EBMOs)

description.narrative:
During the COVID-19 crisis, the Belize Chamber of Commerce and Industry (BCCI) experienced a 9 per cent reduction in membership. Consequently, they sought a solution to counteract this decline. Subsequently, during June and July 2022, the BCCI installed a Customer Relationship Management (CRM) system, aiming to bolster their relationship with their members, cultivate relationships with potential members, and ensure that their engagement strategy and and subsequent membership, services, and marketing efforts are rooted in data.
In September 2022, BCCI’s Chief Executive Officer approved an Action Plan establishing the CRM’s technical and strategic objectives, management and execution procedures, marketing endeavours, and reporting mechanisms.
The CRM system proved instrumental in streamlining BCCI’s operations, optimizing task management, enhancing time efficiency, improving internal and external communication, facilitating knowledge-sharing, and achieving elevated membership retention rates.
Due to an array of measures undertaken by BCCI to expand their membership base, including the CRM installation and the implementation of its Action Plan, the Chamber experienced a notable membership increase of 13 per cent in 2023 compared to 2021. This increase came from the manufacturing, agriculture, services and commerce sectors. FFrom June and September 2022, the ILO, jointly with the ITC-ILO, facilitated the installation of the CRM software at BCCI. Four staff members – the Finance and Administration Manager, Membership Programme Officer, Information & Technology E-Data Specialist and Manager Member Relations – received training to proficiently operate this tool.
Following the installation of the CRM, the ILO assisted BCCI with using the system, assessing its impact on membership information and management, and developing reports on the membership landscape and potential avenues for growth.
Furthermore, the ILO assisted the BCCI to develop an Action Plan that outlined the CRM's technical and strategic objectives, as well as its management, implementation, marketing, and reporting aspects.
